title: Toronto chef Maddy Goldberg leaves fine dining to cook 100 free meals every Tuesday for those in need
summary_full: Toronto chef Maddy Goldberg stepped away from the pressures of fine dining to find a new purpose in cooking for those in need. Every Tuesday, she prepares around 100 free meals using whatever ingredients are available at a local food bank, turning simple, random supplies into nourishing dishes and making a difference in her community.
